correctness.rationale: Triangle-free finite extensions of the fully named induced base realize exactly the complete ordered injective tuple types, by amalgamation into the Henson graph and homogeneity. A new vertex has an independent old neighborhood; a new edge additionally requires disjoint neighborhoods. For three new vertices there are one empty pattern, three edges and three paths, with contributions I^3, ID and J respectively (no triangles). I independently generated rooted types by child-multisets, deduplicated free trees by their invariant centers and counted extensions by transfer of allowed cross-neighborhood states across old edges. Replay python3 /workspace/branches/reproduce_trees.py. This different generator and count matched the 106 packaged CSV entries by unlabelled class. Counts from orders 1 to 10 were 1,1,1,2,3,6,11,23,47,106; the only fibre of size >1 is a doubleton at order ten with I=160, D=8649. Both trees have the stated degree sequence; J=578337 and 578961 yield respectively 9982531 and 9984403 ternary types. The finite cutoff does not establish reconstruction for larger trees or general graphs.

value.rationale: Low-arity logical types give a natural hierarchy of reconstruction invariants on named trees. The joint unary and binary counts nearly reconstruct trees through the first noninjective order, have a unique obstruction there, and are rescued at that order by arity three. Knowing a pair from a different forest-count invariant does not supply the sharp guarantee or its ternary diagnosis, which are the useful outputs here.
